reasons.label: Match result
reasons.text: FC Barcelona are favoured at 51%, against 29% for Aston Villa FC and 20% for the draw. FC Barcelona carry 75 more Elo points into the match. Over the last five: FC Barcelona 1.8 points per game, Aston Villa FC 2.4. They average 2.5 points per game at home this season.

reasons.label: Goals
reasons.text: The model expects 4.32 goals, which puts it over 2.5 at 81%. Across their last five, FC Barcelona and Aston Villa FC have scored 2.9 and conceded 1.7 a game between them.

reasons.label: Self-correction
reasons.text: Adjusted from this competition's own record: goals were predicted 3.11 against 3.63 actual across 182 settled forecasts, so the rate is nudged up 16.9% to stop the model leaning under.

limitations: Only 3 league matches of this season behind the weaker-evidenced side, so form leans on last season.
